name: Tatara Shizue
source:
She is a housekeeper who lives and works at the Doreze residence.

She comes from a poor family, and since her mother has already died, she has been an orphan her whole life.

She has been working for the Doreze family for about 10 years.

She has a well-proportioned and well-fleshed body. Her only merit is her earnestness, and she is not a pushy person.
